layout.horizontal_fine: R26/R27 with fixed eight-pixel left mask

workload: Three-enemy action intervals; both endpoints active; keyboard navigation until native game over
control_check: 1244 camera/tick states match a run without routine breakpoints; total duration matches within5.01cycles; per-frame observation jitter <=5 cycles
emulator:
openMSX 21.0
flavour: opt
components: CORE GL LASERDISC
method: Guest emulated seconds * CPU Hz; entry to matched PC/SP return; tracked descendants subtracted for self time
limitations: First-stage route; natural enemy population, HUD and audio enabled; no hardware validation. ISR body excludes hardware interrupt entry/vector latency. HALT included only in wait_blank; no physical hardware validation.

population.scope: Instrumented real gameplay; normal keyboard controls only; no native state writes; no performance, continuous scanout or physical hardware claim
population.limitations: Visibility counts use prepared complete native car records; actual scanline culling/VRAM fidelity is validated separately. Unobserved smoke/contact/restart events are not claimed as passing.

active_smoke.scope: Excludes death, bonus and stopped/game-over states at both interval endpoints

synthetic_smoke_cache.scope: Synthetic native code-ring bytes; inclusive emulated entry-to-return cycles include MSX memory waits. Excludes simulation, renderer, HUD, IRQ and synchronization. Hook CALL overhead is included in hook cycles; candidate/baseline entry-to-return excludes caller CALL.
synthetic_smoke_cache.exact_comparison: Sparse count and ordered 3-byte records against assembled baseline and independent world-coordinate reference; native code bytes; retained candidate row occupancy; marker AF/BC/DE/HL and preceding sparse list preservation.
synthetic_smoke_cache.limitations: No integrated cartridge, continuous scanout or physical hardware acceptance.

synthetic_dirty_names.scope: Synthetic IDs/names; actual assembled markers, planner, dirty uploader and Ring_UploadNames. Inclusive entry-to-return emulated CPU cycles include memory/IO waits; no IRQ, synchronization, native simulation or other HUD/art preparation. Ring_UploadNames includes its fixed name overlays. Caller CALL excluded.
synthetic_dirty_names.exact_comparison: Both marker bitsets and FIFO group queues; register preservation; Plan seen/Covered; selected-only clearing; both physical VRAM name tables against independent oracle; visible names against actual full-ring uploader; exact OUT98 count and zero covered writes; world IDs unchanged.
synthetic_dirty_names.limitations: Probe bitsets/queues relocated to D000/D100 to isolate Page0 mapping; no continuous gameplay/scanout or physical hardware validation.

synthetic_fast_radar.scope: Inclusive radar entry-to-return elapsed emulated CPU cycles including wait states; synthetic HUD/flag/actor bytes; all 1601 output RAM bytes compared to both original Z80 path and independent reference; no renderer, upload, IRQ, gameplay or scanout claim

synthetic_fast_masks.scope: Synthetic templates/actors. Inclusive entry-to-immediate-return elapsed CPU cycles including memory/IO waits. Display-on SCREEN4 60Hz strict callback. Full SAT/color/pattern RAM, caches/visible state and both pattern VRAM sets/SAT/color VRAM compared. Private row/plane/pattern-id/tail/ink scratch and clobbered registers are excluded. No integrated gameplay/presentation/hardware claim.

synthetic_name_stream.method: Inclusive uploader entry-to-immediate-return guest elapsed time times CPU Hz, including MSX memory/IO wait states. VDP interrupts disabled in this callable-boundary probe.
synthetic_name_stream.scope: Display-on SCREEN4 strict callback; exact current 32x28 visible terrain/HUD/left names compared to independent FULL view over unit deltas and continuous two-buffer routes, reversals, diagonal movement, dirty hidden changes, reveals and restarts. Both raw terrain cache/HUD/pointers/seen/dirty metadata exact, other buffer untouched. Hidden VRAM and private ring scratch may differ. Positive narrow row changes from 31 to 27 repair entering visible rows at identical instruction cost.
synthetic_name_stream.limitations: Synthetic CPU cache bytes and original upload helpers. Ring_Prepare, native gameplay, IRQ/synchronization, physical hardware and complete presentation cadence are not measured here; integration acceptance requires the canonical cartridge route.

boundary_packets.mapper_bank_numbers: One-based banks.bin page indices; resident ROM is mapper bank0
boundary_packets.scope: Exact four current live pattern/color atlas arrays; all FY phases identical for an FX. Unknown prior FX8 forces complete active-byte writes. ROM packets never cross a16KiB page; writes are at most255 bytes. Transfer byte counts only; no measured CPU/gameplay/scanout claim.

evidence_scope: Same controller policy; cadence changes input feedback and samples. Three-enemy navigation ends at native game over; seven-enemy smoke is a separate prior-ROM stress test. Multi-car overrides only population/spawns. No physical hardware validation.
